SELECTED_INDEX: 9  
CONFIDENCE: 0.46  
EXPLANATION: The intense Raman band at 1715 cm⁻¹ fits the ν(C=O) of a saturated aliphatic ketone (rule GFQ-011). Only candidates 2, 8, 9 and 10 contain a ketone. The pair of strong bands at 1108 and 1045 cm⁻¹ correspond to ν(C–O–C) stretching of an aliphatic ether; among the ketone-bearing candidates, only 9 (CCOCC(C=O)CC) also contains an ether linkage, accounting for these two peaks. The strong CH stretches at 2909/2941 cm⁻¹ and CH₂/CH₃ deformations at 1458 cm⁻¹ are consistent with its aliphatic chain. No features requiring unsaturation or aromaticity are present, matching the fully aliphatic structure. Therefore candidate 9 best satisfies the combined carbonyl and ether spectral evidence.
